watch-size-guide.title: Finding your fit
watch-size-guide.content:
WATCH SIZE GUIDE

Comfort comes before a number.

A case diameter is only one part of the fit. Lug-to-lug length, thickness, weight, strap shape and your wrist profile all affect how a watch feels. Our sample products do not have verified measurements; ask for confirmed dimensions before making a real purchase.

Measure your wrist

Wrap a flexible measuring tape around the point where you wear your watch, just above the wrist bone. Keep it comfortably against the skin without pulling it tight. A strip of paper and a ruler also work. Record the circumference in centimetres, then compare it with the model’s stated strap range.

Illustrative case sizes to compare in person
Case diameterVisual impressionWhat to check
Below 34 mmCompactReadable dial and comfortable strap adjustment
34–38 mmUnderstatedLug length and the position on your wrist
39–42 mmBalanced to prominentThickness, weight and sleeve clearance
Above 42 mmBoldLug overhang and comfort while moving

These descriptions are subjective starting points, not rules about gender or wrist size. A watch with long lugs can wear larger than another of the same diameter.

Check the strap and movement

The case should rest securely without pinching. Move your wrist, sit at a desk and try it under your usual sleeve. Bracelet links may require a professional adjustment; confirm that the supplied strap can fit your measurement. Never force a spring bar or alter a bracelet without the correct tools.

Ask a fit question or explore understated watch styles.

watch-care-guide.title: Care for the details
watch-care-guide.content:
WATCH CARE GUIDE

Begin with your model’s instructions.

This is general care guidance. The manufacturer’s instructions for the exact watch, strap and finish take priority. Demonstration specifications in this store are unverified.

A gentle daily routine

Wipe the case and strap gently with a clean, soft, dry cloth. Avoid abrasive pads, solvents, perfume and cleaning sprays. Do not immerse or rinse a watch unless its manual explicitly permits that method and its seals are in suitable condition.

Leather and other straps

Keep leather away from prolonged moisture, direct heat and strong sunlight. Let a damp strap dry naturally in a ventilated place. Metal, textile and synthetic straps have different cleaning requirements; use the instructions supplied for yours. Do not assume that a washable strap makes the watch itself washable.

Water resistance needs verification

A marking alone is not a permanent guarantee. Gaskets age, and a damaged crown or case can compromise protection. Avoid operating buttons or crowns underwater unless the exact manual expressly permits it. Ask a qualified watchmaker about pressure testing and servicing before water exposure.

Storage and servicing

Store the watch in a clean, dry place away from strong magnets, extreme temperatures and impacts. Follow its specific instructions for battery changes, winding, charging and calendar adjustment. A qualified service centre can assess a damaged or unreliable watch.

Read our Journal’s full care and movement guides. Reference: Seiko strap-care guidance.

our-story.title: A personal sense of time
our-story.content:
OUR STORY

More than a watch. A statement.

MUNEEB MART is a watch-store concept built around individuality, clear information and a considered shopping experience. A useful collection should make it easier to discover what you enjoy wearing: the quiet confidence of a clean dial, a warm leather aesthetic or the presence of a bracelet watch.

Our point of view

Style is personal. We organise watches by aesthetic and occasion so you can compare them at your own pace. Our Journal offers practical ways to think about fit, care, gifting and styling.

The next chapter

This initial store uses fictional products and original illustrative photography. The owner will replace them with verified inventory and approved business information before accepting real orders. We do not claim a founding year, store location or trading history.

payment-information.title: Payment information
payment-information.content:
Development orders only

The initial store offers a clearly labelled test method in its development environment. It saves an on-hold WooCommerce order without collecting payment. No watch is dispatched.

Payment preparation

WooCommerce includes configurable Cash on Delivery and Direct Bank Transfer settings. They remain inactive until the owner supplies approved terms and details. Online gateways require an authorised merchant account, HTTPS, supported hosting and successful end-to-end callback tests.

Your information

Do not submit card numbers, online banking passwords or financial credentials through our contact form. Available configured methods appear at checkout. Ask a payment question.

gift-guide.title: A thoughtful moment
gift-guide.content:
THE GIFT GUIDE

Choose a watch with their style in mind.

Start with what they already wear. A simple dial can suit an understated wardrobe, while a bracelet finish may echo a favourite piece of jewellery. Consider wrist fit, readability and practical adjustment before choosing by appearance alone.

For a familiar classic

Explore the Classic Collection and Executive Collection for traditional aesthetics.

For a modern point of view

Discover the Minimalist Collection or browse our Gift Edit.

Keep the budget comfortable

Use the catalog price filters to choose your own range. Demo prices are illustrative. Confirm availability, delivery and return terms with the owner before a real gift purchase. Gift wrapping and guaranteed arrival dates are not configured.
